text:
olivia: Heads-up: CloudNova submitted an add-on mid-term. They extended reserved capacity and moved up payment. Amendment effective 3/15; original contract end date pushed out by 6 months. Sales attached signed amendment in SFDC opp 00678. They want the extra amount invoiced immediately and applied to the new term.
raj: Important: term changed so this is a contract modification that may require prospectively treating remaining and new performance obligations. Need to determine whether to treat as a separate contract or allocate to the modified contract.
melissa: For close I need guidance on journal entries and revenue schedule updates. How much is the add-on? $240,000, of which $20,000 is a one-time migration service. The rest is capacity for the extended term.
olivia: Sales confirms migration service is distinct and delivered on signing. They want that portion recognized now. The capacity is to be amortized over the new extended term (remaining months + 6 months).
raj: Accounting view: separate distinct service = recognize the $20k immediately as revenue on signing. The $220k capacity should be allocated over the revised remaining term. Since term changed, treat modification as prospective if additional goods are distinct; else reallocate transaction price. Sounds like distinct, so prospective.
melissa: Journal entries proposed: (1) invoice posting: 
``nDr Accounts Receivable 240,000
Cr Deferred Revenue - Contract Mods 220,000
Cr Revenue - Services (migration) 20,000
```
(2) amortization monthly for capacity based on new schedule (rev_sched_cn_00678).
olivia: Billing: please include AMEND-00678 on invoice memo and reference original invoices so AR aging ties correctly. Also schedule credit for any onboarding waiver applied last quarter.
raj: Also flag: pricing experiment cohort 14 had promotional credits applied in Jan that affected CloudNova lines. Confirm that the standalone selling price used for allocation excludes transient experiment credits.
melissa: I'll update the revenue schedule feed: rev_sched_cn_00678 with start_date=2026-03-15, total=220,000, term_months=16 (remaining 10 + 6). Monthly amort = 13,750. Posting JE for AR now and attaching amendment doc.
close-bot: JE submitted JE-2026-03-CN1 awaiting approval. Approver: @raj.
raj: Approved. Post JE and tag month-end tracker.
messaging: olivia: I'll notify sales and legal. melissa: make sure revrec export includes the immediate $20k recognized. Once posted, update close checklist and leave a note on audit folder.
melissa: Done. JE posted, schedule created, and audit folder updated with amendment PDF. Closing loop: CloudNova add-on accounted prospectively; migration service recognized at signing; capacity amortized over revised term. :white_check_mark:
